item.title: User Experience Improvement Program
item.description: Purpose and Content To continuously improve the quality, performance, and user experience of the KubeSphere product, we have established the User Experience Improvement Program (hereinafter referred to as "UEIP"). Participating in the UEIP will help us analyze usage patterns, diagnose issues, and prioritize the development of future product features. The information that may be collected under this program is non-personally identifiable, aggregated data, primarily including: Feature Usage: The frequency and duration of usage for various functional modules.
